records.query: What are the procedures for installing, removing, and requisitioning vehicle markings, including reflective tape?
records.reference: Vehicle markings, including reflective tape, are installed by cleaning the surface, removing the liner, positioning the tape, and applying firm pressure. records.query: What caution is taken into consideration while using high-pressure wash equipment, and explain the function of the portable, 45-gallon, foam-generating cleaning unit?
records.reference: When using high-pressure wash equipment, caution must be taken to ensure it is never used on aircraft landing gear and components, wheels, and brakes, as it can force lubricants out of bearings and attachment points, causing corrosion and wear problems. The function of the portable, 45-gallon, foam-generating cleaning unit is to dispense foam. This cleaning unit is a simplified, portable, pressure-operated, foam-dispensing system that uses the available air supply as its power source to force cleaning solution into the hose and create foam.
records.answer: High-pressure wash equipment producing more than 175 PSI nozzle pressure shall not be used to apply cleaning compounds unless specifically authorized by the equipment System Program Manager (SPM); failure could result in damage to or destruction of equipment or loss of mission effectiveness. Also, if approved by the SPM, the equipment must use only approved cleaning compounds, a 50:50 water-to-cleaner mix, 40-degree flat fan nozzles, and a nozzle standoff of at least 12 inches. The portable 45-gallon foam-generating cleaning unit is a simplified, portable, pressure-operated foam-dispensing system that uses available air supply as its power source without pumps; air is metered directly into the pressurized solution chamber, forcing cleaning solution into the hose to create foam. The foam is applied to the surface, dwells for a minimum of one minute without drying, then is scrubbed with a cleaning kit, brush, or cloth and rinsed. Foam consistency is adjusted with the cleaning compound metering valve and air valve, and the tank is pressurized to 30 to 70 PSI at the air regulator.
